execution_script.description: Complete Python source for the execution transaction.

return_schema.description: JSON Schema for the model-facing result of the execution transaction.

semantics: Ask the model for the exact current user prompt.
Inject the mandatory prompt-to-goal KB entry and request a goal.
Inject the mandatory goal-to-query KB entry and request execution-KB queries.
Run the queries deterministically and expose compact selectable KB topic projections plus the mandatory topic-selection KB entry.
Resolve the model-selected topic IDs to their full canonical KB records.
Inject the full selected KB records plus the mandatory execution-script construction KB entry.
Request a terminal outcome envelope containing result and transition.
The result must be the executable contract and is validated only by this transaction's return_schema.
The transition is consumed by the higher-level mode controller and is not part of the model-facing result.
The transaction receipt is generated separately by the transaction runtime and is not part of the model-facing result.
